migration_steps.activity: Perform a comprehensive cryptographic inventory and asset discovery covering RSA-2048 TLS certificates, ECDSA P-256 signatures, RSA-3072 key wrapping, and ECDH P-256 key exchange. Document algorithms, key sizes, certificates, dependencies, data flows, and system owners.

Conduct a quantum risk assessment prioritizing RSA-3072 key wrapping and ECDH P-256 key exchange because they protect sensitive information that may remain confidential for 10 to 15 years. Assess harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure. Include RSA-2048 TLS certificates and ECDSA P-256 signatures in the migration risk assessment.

Engage Thales and the third-party core banking platform vendor to obtain written confirmation of ML-KEM and ML-DSA compatibility, supported firmware and software versions, licensing requirements, implementation timelines, and migration roadmaps. Continue documentation, procurement planning, and vendor discussions during the change freeze where permitted. Do not assume vendor readiness.

Conduct controlled non-production laboratory testing of NIST-standardized ML-KEM for key establishment and ML-DSA for digital signatures. Evaluate interoperability, cryptographic performance, key and signature sizes, HSM integration, application compatibility, latency, and resource consumption. Proceed only with available compatible test environments and do not assume production HSM support.
prerequisites: Availability of suitable non-production cryptographic implementations

migration_steps.activity: Prepare a controlled, phased production migration beginning with the highest-risk cryptographic dependencies. Migrate key establishment and digital signature mechanisms only after HSM and core banking compatibility, security validation, interoperability testing, procurement, and operational approvals are completed. Maintain appropriate classical cryptographic protection during transition and establish rollback procedures.
prerequisites: Written core banking vendor compatibility confirmation

blockers.blocker: Thales Luna Network HSM 7 has not confirmed PQC compatibility, firmware support, or delivery timeline for ML-KEM and ML-DSA.
blockers.reason: Production PQC migration cannot proceed without confirmed HSM firmware compatibility and validated ML-KEM and ML-DSA support in the hardware security module.
blockers.resolution_required: Obtain written Thales vendor confirmation, supported firmware and software versions, production compatibility information, and implementation and delivery timeline.

blockers.blocker: The third-party core banking platform vendor has not confirmed PQC compatibility or provided a migration roadmap.
blockers.reason: Application-layer PQC migration is blocked until the core banking vendor provides software support, PQC compatibility confirmation, and a migration roadmap for its platform.
blockers.resolution_required: Obtain written compatibility confirmation, vendor migration roadmap, supported implementation options, and integration and testing requirements.

vendor_dependencies.evidence_required: Written confirmation of ML-KEM and ML-DSA support, supported firmware versions, production compatibility, and implementation timeline.
